author: gltz
name: Streamers
description: Posts when Twitch/YouTube channels go live. React to a live post to get pinged the next time they go live.
install_msg: Thanks for installing Streamers! Owner: set Twitch creds with `streamers twitchcreds <client_id> <client_secret>` (app at dev.twitch.tv/console). Admin: add streamers with `streamers add twitch <login>` or `streamers add youtube <UCchannelid>`, set the post channel with `streamers channel <channel>`. Everyone: react to a live post to get pinged next time that streamer goes live.
short: Twitch/YouTube live announcements with reaction-based pings.
